title: Japanese Macaroni Pasta with Crumbly Topping
description: A savory, lacto-vegetarian Japanese dish featuring macaroni, a crumbly topping, and comforting flavors.
instructions: Cook the macaroni in boiling water until it is al dente, then set it aside.
Combine the kombu, soy sauce, sake, and sesame oil in a saucepan to make the dashi broth.
Add the miso paste to the dashi broth and whisk until it's smooth, then set it aside.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the grated daikon radish and carrot to the skillet and cook until they are softened.
Add the cooked macaroni to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the dashi broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a baking dish.
Top the macaroni mixture with the breadcrumbs and sesame seeds.
Bake the macaroni in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.
Remove the macaroni from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
